title: Bluetooth: update UUID registery
description:
Update the UUIDs based on present day registery by the bluetooth-SIG,
and make adjustments to the tooling to address issues in it.

notes.body:
added 4 commits
  • eb2e35eb...61c68a60 - 3 commits from branch wireshark:master
  • cd09f73c - Bluetooth: update UUID registery
[Compare with previous version](/wireshark/wireshark/-/merge_requests/16476/diffs?diff_id=1067506373&start_sha=eb2e35eb454fd4bfbb5dc8df6818fbc3a9619e53)
